species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 58°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 18–22 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.
West wind at 21 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
